quest.title: Lights, Kamera, Action!
quest.description: It's time you shot a film starring your Saurian companion!
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000, Unknown Item #364510 x1

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Look, look, {NICKNAME}! There's a Kamera here, and some props too. D'you think this is a film set?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But these houses... they're so tiny. They make you look like a giant!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr... Rawrrr!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawrrr...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, looks like we're real "big" shots now, huh?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Suddenly, yet utterly seamlessly, a Natlan local joins the conversation...

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: Oh, hello! Are you guys interested in filmmaking too? If so, then I beseech you — join forces with me, Akatanga, to bring this burgeoning new trend to the lands of Natlan, that it might sweep all before it!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #How come you're so hyped all of a sudden, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Anyone'd think you were a film buff yourself, chiming in like that!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Raaaawrrr!

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: You have a keen eye, little one! In truth, everything you see here was set up with the sole intention of making a certain little Tepetlisaur the next big star!

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: A great pity that my friend took the little fellow away. We had an almighty spat over our creative differences, after which she stormed off with my most important actor... and now they are gone. *sigh*...

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: I should never have mixed friends and business. The project failed, and I lost my friend too... In other words, I am doubly defeated.

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: But that's all water under the bridge — for now, what stands before me but another little Tepetlisaur, starry-eyed and eager for stardom! With such enthusiasm, what could go wrong? We shall make the next big hit!

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: So, what do you say? If you can help me complete this timeless, groundbreaking work of mine, I'll be sure to reward you handsomely!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We can help, but... We still don't know what this film of yours is even about.

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: Well, here's what I've got so far...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: *bzzt*— *bang* A sudden flash of dazzling white light heralds the arrival of an uninvited guest to the tribal settlement, perfectly round but for a single spike. *crackle* *bzzt* As it stops for a moment on the grass, a scorching smell begins to waft upon the air. "Eek! An emissary of Xibalba!" The tribesfolk look terrified when they see it. *bang* *crackle* *bzzt* "A foul abomination with no teeth... It's coming our way! It will surely devour us all!"

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: #Just as the wicked villain is about to break through the tribe's defenses... *BOOM* *BOOM* Our savior with the red tail scarf appears, seemingly out of nowhere. "Where did it come from?" the tribesfolk gasp, marveling at its sturdy claws, stronger than obsidian itself, and capable of carving through rock of any kind. "But faced with such a slippery, shameless foe... Surely even for {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, this is a fight that cannot be w..."

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: "Rawrrrr!" cries our savior — in more of a piercing shriek than an angry roar — and the evil, toothless monstrosity begins to pulsate. A raging blaze lights up the sky, followed by a thunderous rumbling... then waves of heat begin to flow forth, hotter even than liquid phlogiston. Immersed in such heat, the toothless fiend is vanquished. "Hot, hot, hot!" cry the tribesfolk, who have narrowly escaped disaster, as the aftershock surges through their ranks.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: But when they look up, they discover that their savior with the red tail scarf has vanished without a trace, as suddenly and inexplicably as it first arrived...

choices.text: Hundred and ten percent sounds like some kind of scam.

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: Even if it's not an overnight sensation, I'll still compensate you for helping out with the shoot. A win-win situation, no?

choices.text: This would make a great house for you, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously, what are you on about? There's no way Paimon could live in such a small house. She couldn't even stretch her arms and legs out!

talks.objective: Place the Wooden Barrel somewhere suitable

dialogues.speaker: Akatanga
dialogues.text: What's up? Need me to run you through it once more?

choices.text: Can you tell me what I have to do again?

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: First, set out the performance props. Place the Wooden Barrel in the <color=#00E1FFFF>middle of the scene, without blocking the main character or the set</color>, and place the Elemental Bait near <color=#00E1FFFF>where the antagonist enters from</color>.

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: When it's time to do so, <color=#00E1FFFF>guide the antagonist to a spot near the Wooden Barrel</color>, then move back to a safe position and <color=#00E1FFFF>smash the Wooden Barrel</color>.

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: Then best of luck, I'm counting on you!

talks.objective: Place the Elemental Bait somewhere suitable

dialogues.speaker: Akatanga
dialogues.text: When the actors are in position, the two of you must <color=#00E1FFFF>guide the antagonist towards the Wooden Barrel</color> as planned, then scram with equal haste. Once you've reached a safe position, simply <color=#00E1FFFF>smash the Wooden Barrel</color>.

talks.objective: Wait for your Saurian companion to get in position
Get into position at the designated spot
Get into position at the designated spot

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Why's a temp suddenly filling in as the antagonist? Nobody ran it by us!

dialogues.speaker: Akatanga
dialogues.text: Shh! Quiet, we're about to start shooting!

dialogues.speaker: Narration
dialogues.text: "No, such evil cannot be forgiven... rest in peace, my friends. Oh, the agony... Seeing the fallen brothers of the tribe, how can one not be moved to tears?"

dialogues.speaker: Narration
dialogues.text: "But now is not the time for tears. Today, I face the all-scor{RUBY#[D]Xolotl}ching emissary, and come what may, I shall have my revenge—"

dialogues.speaker: Narration
dialogues.text: A ferocious, toothless beast whose demeanor is as cool and composed as a Lavender Melon, that legendary fruit from far across the sea!

dialogues.speaker: Narration
dialogues.text: What sort of a face was it, I hear you ask? A visage of such merciless cruelty that even gulping down volcanically spicy Tatacos would leave it unmoved. Truly terrifying...

dialogues.speaker: Narration
dialogues.text: "This time, this time your remorse shall be great indeed!" And with that, the giant beast with the red tail scarf unleashed the Mighty Meaty Fireball it had honed through countless hours of practice...

dialogues.speaker: Akatanga
dialogues.text: Alright, now's the time! Lure the Electro Slime towards the Wooden Barrel, then smash it to smithereens!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What, just smash a barrel? How's that gonna make anyone buy this whole "Mighty Meaty Fireball" business?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds kinda weird, but... If you say so, we'll give it a try.

talks.objective: Lure the antagonist near the barrel, and smash the barrel

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Raaaawrrr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Steady on, no need to rush!

dialogues.speaker: Akatanga
dialogues.text: To tell you the truth, I was just a teeny-tiny bit worried for the little one just now. I wanted the effect to be as realistic as possible, so I might have gone a bit overboard on the explosives...

choices.text: Nearly blew the whole settlement sky high...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawrawrawrawrawr...

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: In any case, with this experience to go on, I'll know how to do things better next time. Thank you all for your help. Now, how about we take a look at how it turned out?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: To all of your surprise, neither the savior with the red tail scarf, nor the evil crackling antagonist, nor the thrilling shots of explosions seem to have made it into the final cut — only close-ups of Akatanga's constantly changing expressions...

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: I... I'm the star of the show?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no, that's not right! Could it be that the Kamera...

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: Well, it's true that this is the first time I've ever officially used a Kamera, but... Surely I didn't... get it the wrong way round?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Easy for you to say, but what about all that hard work we just put in?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wooo... Rrrooo... Rrawrr...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #And {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} was so looking forward to seeing it...

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: I'm so sorry, it's all my fault! Alright, how about this... Just think of the previous events as a rehearsal. We'll do it again, and this time, it'll be the real deal. I'll do my absolute best, and everything possible, to shoot the best film I can possibly shoot!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrrooo... Rawrrrr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Seems like you're eager to give this another shot, huh, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Let's do it, then. Hope nothing goes wrong this time...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You follow the same process as before and finally get the result you wanted...

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: Incredible! Absolute perfection! That completely and utterly exceeded my expectations.

choices.text: A complete, utter, absolute... piece of cake.

response.speaker: Akatanga
response.text: Aside from the payment we agreed upon, I'll also give you this picture to keep as a souvenir. *sigh* I must say, this really has turned out to be my magnum opus. Of course, I couldn't have done it without your help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Whoa, you look so imposing, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! Not bad at all.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Raaaawrrr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe, looks like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is happy with how it turned out too. Well, all's well that ends well, as they say!

choices.text: Director, where's that bonus you promised us?
Have you... used a Kamera before?
Even for me, that felt a bit too dangerous.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! What if someone got hurt, or there was a fire or something?

dialogues.speaker: Akatanga
dialogues.text: No, that won't do. It didn't turn out how I imagined at all... Let's start over.

dialogues.speaker: Akatanga
dialogues.text: Who knows, perhaps that friend of mine might even have a change of heart once she sees this... Haha.
